story.iWant: to review all agent responses and override the choice
story.soThat: I can pick a different persona answer when needed
story.tasks: - Task 1: Display all persona responses in aggregated format - Task 2: Implement --select flag for manual override - Task 3: Log override decisions with metadata - Task 4: Add toggles for CLI and MCP - Task 5: Tests

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Given consensus output shown, When user runs `jarvis query --select Supportive`, Then CLI re-renders Supportive Rick answer with sources, And decision logged with override metadata.

doc.snippet: VotingResult provides scores and winner - display and allow override

artifact.reason: Extend MCP query tool with override parameters
Store all persona responses for override capability

story-context.constraints: - All persona responses must be stored (not just winner) for override - Validate --select persona name against active personas - Store override metadata in voting_metadata JSONB (extends Story 4.3 schema) - CLI output must be readable with rich formatting

interface.name: aggregate_responses
interface.signature: def aggregate_responses(responses: List[PersonaResponse], voting_result: VotingResult) -> str

tests.standards: Use pytest with rich output capture. Test --show-all displays all responses. Test --select with valid/invalid names. Verify override metadata persistence.
tests.ideas: - Test aggregated format displays 4 personas correctly - Test --select validation (invalid persona name → error) - Test override metadata stored in database - Integration test: query → --show-all → --select "Supportive Rick"
